verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs describe the core of this story. The video model supports image-to-video and video-to-video with character reference. Motion transfer applies a source video to "new subjects, scenes, or styles," and Luma Agents carry "style references" into every asset. Together these let a creator point at reference media and generate new footage guided by it. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how a style reference conditions new video generation (as opposed to modifying the source clip), stated limits on style fidelity, and independent hands-on corroboration of reference-driven style transfer.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style
